result.rationale: The plan cites NICE passages that discuss ROM risk thresholds (>24 h) and CRP usage, but the text attributes quantitative risk percentages, point values, specific urgency timing, and a 48‑72 h antibiotic course that are not found in the supplied evidence. Citations are therefore mismatched or incomplete. No numeric dosing is presented, so no ungrounded dose claim is identified.

In 2026, evidence from 3 studies showed that the risk of early‑onset neonatal infection increased as the time between prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM) at term and birth increased. ... using their clinical experience, the committee decided to keep this at more than 24 hours.
